Pivotal Health is hiring a

Remote Senior Software Engineer Case Execution

About Pivotal HealthPivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, they’re often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement they’re entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. We’re building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.About the RoleWe're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.What You'll Do* Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.\n* Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform.\n* Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability.\n* Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with the Integrations team, Case Strategy team, and other engineering and product partners to ensure systems are well-connected and aligned with how the broader platform operates.\n* Contribute to front-end and admin workflows where needed: The role is primarily backend-focused, but you'll contribute to internal-facing UI and ops tooling where the product requires it.\n\nWho You Are* 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus\n* Strong engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building data-heavy, workflow-oriented systems\n* Experience working on complex, data-driven decision logic or orchestration problems: you're comfortable with systems where correctness and sequencing both matter\n* Comfortable operating in a collaborative, fast-moving startup environment where ownership and requirements evolve\n* Python experience; able to work effectively in a Python-based backend environment\n* Self-directed and proactive: you identify problems and drive them to resolution without heavy oversight\n* Strong communicator who collaborates well across engineering, product, and adjacent teams\n\nExtra Credit If You Have* Experience with healthcare-specific data or HealthTech systems\n* Exposure to data-heavy architectures or problems adjacent to data engineering without being a pure data engineer\n* Familiarity with tools like Snowflake, dbt, or Databricks\n* Some front-end experience to support admin workflow contributions\n\nWhy You’ll Love Working HereWe’re a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. While we primarily hire around our core hubs–Los Angeles and New York–we remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.If you’re excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, we’d love to hear from you.Benefits Include:* Competitive compensation, including equity\n* Full health, dental, and vision coverage\n* Retirement savings plan through 401(k)\n* Flexible time off\n* Opportunities for company-wide connection and events\n\nReady to Make an Impact?\nWe’re building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and let’s transform healthcare reimbursement together.Employment InformationWork AuthorizationCandidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.Equal Employment OpportunityPivotal Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.Reasonable AccommodationsPivotal Health provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you need assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know.Background ChecksEmployment is contingent upon successful completion of applicable background checks, where permitted by law.At-Will EmploymentEmployment with Pivotal Health is at-will and may be terminated by either party at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law. \n\n#Salary and compensation\n $190,000 — $220,000/year\n

Job Summary

Support the Data Analytics team by assisting with data validation, report generation, and basic analysis to help ensure data accuracy and enable informed business decision-making.

Responsibilities:

  • Reporting, Analysis & Insight Communication
    • Prepare reports and perform data analysis to support data-driven decision-making
    • Monitor key business performance metrics to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies
    • Assist in building and maintaining dashboards and reports for performance tracking
    • Communicate data insights to stakeholders in a clear, concise, and actionable way
  • Data Quality & Validation
    • Support the validation and upkeep of data accuracy across dashboards and data pipelines
  • Cross-Team Collaboration
    • Respond to data requests from cross-functional teams, including coordinating requirements and providing basic analytical support
  • Process Improvement & Documentation
    • Document data processes and workflows, and contribute to improving existing data practices and standards
    • Explore and apply new tools and methods to enhance the efficiency and quality of data work
  • Ad-Hoc Analytical Projects
    • Assist with ad-hoc data tasks and analytical projects as needed


Requirements:

  • 0–1 year of experience in data analysis or a related field.
  • Foundational knowledge of SQL, Excel, and data visualization platforms such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Exposure to Python for data analysis is an added advantage.
  • Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on maintaining data quality and accuracy.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present findings and insights clearly.
  • Demonstrates a proactive mindset and willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and analytical techniques.
  • Well-organized, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks effectively.


Don't miss out on this exciting opportunity! Apply now at www.seahubasia.com.

Harvey Nash is hiring a

Remote Human Resources Specialist

Harvey Nash USA has been engaged to find a talented HR Operations Specialist for a leading healthcare organization committed to delivering exceptional employee experiences through operational excellence.


Job Title: HR Operations Specialist

Location: Remote (California Residents Only)

Duration: 6-Month Contract


About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused HR Operations Specialist to join a dynamic HR team. This role is responsible for supporting a wide range of HR operations and employee inquiries while ensuring timely, accurate, and high-quality service delivery. The ideal candidate is resourceful, takes ownership of their work, communicates effectively, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.


Day-to-Day Responsibilities

  • Review HRIS transactional process requests daily and weekly, approving or rejecting transactions based on established HR policies and procedures.
  • Understand core HR policies and processes to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant transaction processing.
  • Escalate complex transactional issues and policy-related questions to HR leadership when appropriate.
  • Manage employee HR cases, calls, and chats involving benefits, compensation, wellness programs, leave of absence, payroll, performance management, and other HR-related inquiries.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional HR teams including Benefits, Payroll, HR Technology, Compensation, Talent Acquisition, Employee Relations, Retirement, Eligibility, and Corporate Real Estate to resolve employee issues.
  • Deliver exceptional customer service by managing cases with accuracy, attention to detail, and professionalism while enhancing the employee experience.
  • Identify trends in employee inquiries and partner with leadership on process improvements or escalations.
  • Serve as a trusted HR resource while ensuring compliance with organizational policies and service standards.


Must-Have Skills

  • Resourceful and self-sufficient with the ability to work independently and efficiently.
  • Demonstrates strong ownership, accountability, and a growth mindset by learning quickly and embracing feedback.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a customer-first approach.
  • Strong understanding of HR processes, policies, and employee support functions.
  • Experience handling HR service requests or HR operations in a shared services or HR support environment.


Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Oracle HCM.
  • Experience with UKG (Ultipro) and/or ServiceNow.
  • Passion for Human Resources with broad HR knowledge; SHRM-CP certification is a plus.
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience supporting multiple HR Centers of Excellence.


Education

  • Associate's or bachelor’s degree in human resources or a related field OR 5+ years of HR experience in lieu of a degree.


A reasonable, good faith estimate of the minimum and maximum hourly wage for this position is $25.00 - $29.00 per hour on W2, depending on experience.


About Us

Harvey Nash is a national, full-service talent management firm specializing in technology and professional staffing. Our company was founded with a mission to serve as the talent partner of choice by connecting exceptional talent with leading organizations across a wide range of industries.

Ready is hiring a

Remote Care Navigator Level 1

Job Type:
Full-Time

Location:
Fully Remote (U.S.)

Reports To:
Care Navigator Supervisor

Pay:
$22.00 per hour

Classification:
Non-Exempt / Hourly

Are you a healthcare professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants more than “just a call center job”? myLaurel is hiring a Care Navigator, Level 1 to serve as the critical first connection our patients have with the myLaurel care team.

This is a specialized role for someone who wants to build foundational skills in healthcare navigation, clinical problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration — with real room to grow. You'll be the voice patients and caregivers turn to for scheduling, education, and support as they navigate their care journey at home.

We're looking for high-performers who are proactive, adaptable, and eager to grow within a high-impact startup environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Primary Point of Contact: Serve as the lead contact for patients and caregivers via high-volume inbound and outbound calls.
  • Scheduling: Coordinate and schedule in-home and virtual care visits efficiently and accurately.
  • Patient Education: Educate patients on myLaurel program services and set clear, empathetic expectations for their care journey.
  • Post-Visit Support: Manage critical post-visit needs, including equipment coordination, pharmacy requests, and clinical documentation.
  • Systems Management: Maintain high-integrity documentation of every interaction within our internal systems and Electronic Health Record (EHR).
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate daily with clinical and operations teams to deliver a seamless, “white-glove” patient experience.



What You Bring

  • 2+ years of professional experience in a healthcare call center or patient facing environment.
  • Proficiency with Electronic Health Record (EHR) platforms (e.g., Epic, Athena, Cerner, or similar) required.
  • A dedicated, private, HIPAA-compliant workspace with a door.
  • Reliable high-speed internet (minimum 20 Mbps download / 5 Mbps upload).
  • Exceptional active listening skills and the ability to multitask across multiple software systems while maintaining an empathetic phone presence.
  • High school diploma or GED required.



Why Work With Us


  • Join a mission-driven team bringing hospital-level care into patients' homes.
  • Step onto a defined Care Navigator career path, with room to grow into senior and specialist roles.
  • Fully remote role with a supportive, collaborative team culture.
  • Be part of a high-growth startup transforming acute and transitional care for frail, elderly, and medically complex patients.



About MyLaurel
myLaurel was founded on the belief that a meaningful portion of hospital care can — and should — be delivered in the comfort of home. As a tech-enabled medical group, we provide on-demand acute and transitional care to frail, elderly, or medically complex patients at home, helping them avoid the traditional pathway of ambulance, emergency department, hospital admission, and post-acute facility care.

For high-risk populations, myLaurel achieves 33% lower ED utilization, a 49% absolute reduction in readmissions, and a Net Promoter Score of 97. myLaurel has been named to Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and the New York Digital Health 100. Learn more at mylaurelhealth.com.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

HiredBuddy is hiring a

Remote Junior Data Analyst

About HiredBuddy

At HiredBuddy, we connect domain specialists and subject-matter experts with leading AI research labs to shape and train the next generation of artificial intelligence. We focus on high-quality data annotation, RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback), and model evaluation across various domains, ranging from STEM and software engineering to linguistics and data science.

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly analytical Junior Data Analyst based in the United States to join our growing remote team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in monitoring dataset quality, analyzing annotator performance metrics, optimizing labeling pipelines, and delivering insights that improve our AI training data pipelines.

This is an ideal role for an early-career analyst passionate about the intersection of data, machine learning, and AI operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Quality Assurance: Audit, clean, and validate large datasets generated by our network of AI trainers and domain experts to ensure high precision and adherence to guidelines.
  • Performance & Metrics Tracking: Analyze annotator accuracy, turnaround times, and throughput using SQL, Python, and BI dashboards to help optimize operations.
  • Pipeline Optimization: Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Operations, AI Specialists, and Product) to identify bottlenecks in data labeling pipelines and recommend data-driven solutions.
  • Reporting & Dashboards: Build, maintain, and update daily/weekly operational reports and dashboards for internal stakeholders and client leads.
  • Guideline Calibration: Analyze edge cases and error patterns in dataset outputs to help refine project annotation instructions and rubrics.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Technical Skills:
  • Proficiency with SQL for data querying, aggregation, and analysis.
  • Practical knowledge of Python or R for data manipulation (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
  • Experience with visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
  • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills (Pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, complex formulas).
  • Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a high degree of attention to detail when working with complex datasets.
  • Communication: Ability to clearly translate data findings into actionable insights for non-technical team members.
  • Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, data annotation workflows, or RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback).
  • Prior experience or internship experience in an operations-focused analyst role.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the US.
  • Cutting-Edge Industry Exposure: Gain hands-on experience at the forefront of AI model training and evaluation.
  • Growth Opportunities: Direct mentorship and opportunities to advance within a fast-growing tech environment.
  • Competitive Compensation: Hourly/Salaried rate commensurate with experience.

Greenlight Action is hiring a

Remote Program Administration Manager

Campaigns

  • Full Time
  • Remote / Occasional Travel
  • Salary $75,000 - $100,000

Organization Overview

Greenlight America is the leading grassroots campaign force powering the nation's clean energy transition at the local level. Our team supports local residents and organizations working to get clean energy built in their communities. Since our founding in 2023, we have enabled volunteers to advance thousands of megawatts' worth of utility-scale projects across the country, helping hundreds of communities to say yes to the benefits of a clean energy future.

Position Overview

Greenlight America is hiring a Program Administration Manager to help lead program administration and operations for our growing campaigns department.

The Program Administration Manager supports the Senior Director of Campaigns in running a growing department. They build department-wide systems, support internal communications, and lead special projects, while also managing core operational functions and providing executive support to the Senior Director. Greenlight's campaigns department has scaled quickly, growing from a single person to more than 30 staff in under three years. This role is well suited to someone excited by that stage of growth, who is comfortable identifying gaps in fast-built systems and bringing the structure and sophistication needed for the department's next chapter. The successful candidate will be a highly organized, proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes initiative to build better systems, and brings strong professional judgment. They will genuinely enjoy working as part of a team and build trust easily across people and functions. The Program Administration Manager reports to the Senior Director of Campaigns.

Primary Roles And Responsibilities

Program Administration – 50%

  • Design and improve department-wide systems and structures, working closely with the Senior Director to identify gaps and build practical, scalable solutions.
  • Serve as the lead for the department retreat and other all-team convenings, from logistics through content flow.
  • Design onboarding, structure, and support systems for a new department internship/fellowship program.
  • Establish and maintain a regular department communication cadence (e.g. weekly updates, department call recaps), including best practices and norms for internal comms.
  • Draft and/or coordinate internal communications on behalf of the Senior Director, including the weekly department update.
  • Maintain organized department files, shared resources, and documentation so the team can work efficiently.
  • Support culture and engagement efforts for the department, in partnership with the Senior Director.
  • Provide light-touch executive support to the Senior Director, including coordinating travel logistics and arranging team gestures for staff.
  • Take on ad hoc special projects at the Senior Director's direction as departmental needs evolve.

Campaign Operations Management – 50%

  • Coordinate with Ops on the campaigns department's budget management, including designing better systems for tracking expenditures, flagging variances, and working with staff and finance to keep spending on track.
  • Identify gaps in departmental operations systems and processes and develop practical solutions that scale with the team's growth.
  • Manage campaign operational workflows such as contractor invoicing and train campaign staff on those workflows.
  • Build and maintain campaign systems for accurate expense categorization, ensuring campaign staff understand and follow financial protocols.
  • Proactively coordinate work across campaign staff, operations staff, and other key stakeholders using clear, direct, and thoughtful communication.
  • Drive adoption of financial and operational practices through effective communication, rollout, and follow-up.
  • Serve as a responsive point of contact for campaign staff, contractors, and others, addressing operational questions with a caring, helpful approach.
  • Support onboarding coordination for new campaigns department hires.

Experience And Qualifications

We are especially interested in candidates with the following qualifications:

  • 3+ years of relevant program administration or operations experience, ideally in a nonprofit, campaign, or mission-driven environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with a track record of building and implementing systems and processes. Familiarity with project management and automation tools (e.g. Asana, Zapier) is a plus.
  • Experience rolling out new processes and driving adoption with a team, including situations without direct management authority.
  • Experience with budget management and financial tracking; comfort working with spreadsheets and financial data.
  • Experience working with a senior leader to translate department priorities and goals into action.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience drafting communications on behalf of senior leaders.
  • Comfort and experience building relationships, communicating, and coordinating work with staff across an organization, including leadership and staff outside the assigned department.
  • Demonstrated ability to act as a responsive point of contact to field incoming questions, support problem-solving, and resolve issues in a way that builds trust.
  • Exercises discretion and good judgment when handling sensitive information.
  • Excitement for taking systems built in a fast-growing organization and bringing them to the next level of maturity and sophistication; comfortable identifying problems and building solutions from scratch.
  • Proactive, self-directed work style with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Comfort in a fast-growing organization where processes are still being built and flexibility is required.
  • Passion for accelerating the clean energy transition.

Compensation And Benefits

The base annual salary for this position is $75,000-$100,000. We offer an excellent benefits package which includes 100% employer paid premiums for medical, dental, and vision insurance, unlimited paid time off, monthly technology stipend, and retirement contributions through 401k and Roth plans.

TO APPLY

  • Submit a resume and respond to the applicant questionnaire via this link.
  • Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the role is filled. If you require accommodations so that you may participate in the selection process, please email accommodations@greenlightamerica.org.

Due to the volume of applicants, we will only contact applicants whose skill sets and experience meet our needs.

Experiencia: Mínimo 1 año trabajando detrás de la barra (preparación de coctelería clásica, de autor y bebidas frías).

Red Rover is hiring a

Remote Marketing Associate

Description

Overview:

Red Rover is seeking an organized, proactive, and eager-to-learn budding marketer or early-career marketing professional to support the execution, coordination, and day-to-day operations of our growing marketing organization as a Marketing Associate.

The Marketing Associate plays an important role in helping ongoing campaigns, programs, and initiatives stay organized, execute successfully, and remain aligned across marketing and cross-functional teams.

This role collaborates across teams, contributing to a wide variety of marketing initiatives and projects. Working alongside experienced marketing leaders, the Marketing Associate will build a broad foundation across campaign marketing, product marketing, content strategy, customer marketing, field marketing and events, sales enablement, and go-to-market execution while helping the team operate more efficiently as Red Rover continues to grow.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, collaborative, and detail-oriented, and enjoys variety, continuous learning, and fast-moving projects. They're eager to gain hands-on experience across all aspects of modern B2B SaaS marketing.

What You’ll Do

Marketing campaign & program support

  • Support the planning, coordination, and execution of integrated marketing campaigns and strategic initiatives across multiple marketing programs
  • Assist with email campaign preparation and scheduling, webinar coordination and preparation, campaign timelines, promotional communications, marketing calendar coordination, campaign asset coordination, website & CRM management, and cross-functional coordination
  • Help ensure campaigns remain organized, on schedule, and aligned across marketing and sales teams

Cross-functional coordination & team support

  • Help coordinate projects, communication, and day-to-day marketing initiatives across sales, SDR, and marketing teams
  • Support activities including project timeline management, meeting preparation, action item tracking, workflow coordination, internal communications, marketing request management, project documentation, team follow-up

Event & field marketing support

  • Support the planning and execution of webinars, conferences, customer events, regional marketing initiatives, and field marketing programs alongside marketing team
  • Assist with webinar event logistics, registration management, presentation and speaker coordination, promotional campaigns and communications, sales coordination, post-event follow-ups, etc.
  • Assist with strategic planning and onsite execution logistics for tradeshows, conferences, and regional events
  • Help contribute to memorable customer and prospect experiences before, during, and after each event

Content & marketing asset coordination

  • Support the marketing organization in publishing and maintaining marketing content library and sales resources across multiple channels
  • Assist with blog publishing, marketing asset organization, webinar materials, sales collateral materials, digital asset management, social media scheduling, website content coordination, and content library management

Marketing operations & team organization

  • Help maintain the operational foundation that keeps the marketing organization running efficiently
  • Support activities including project tracking, campaign organization, campaign performance reporting support, workflow management, budget tracking assistance, tradeshow and events calendar management, etc.
  • Assist in marketing database updates and campaign and program builds alongside marketing operations team

Professional growth & continuous learning

  • Take an active role in developing marketing knowledge and expanding level of responsibilities over time
  • Demonstrate curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to continuously improve and learn while eager to build experience and deepen knowledge across demand generation, campaign marketing, product marketing, brand marketing, content strategy, customer marketing and advocacy, field marketing and events, marketing operations, go-to-market strategy, and AI and traditional or emerging marketing technologies

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • 0-3 years of experience in marketing, communications, business, customer-facing roles, events, or related fields
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field preferred
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail, proven project management skills preferred
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Positive attitude with a willingness to learn and take initiative
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
  • Strong follow-through and reliability
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with multiple teams
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office and SharePoint/OneDrive
  • Experience with Canva, HubSpot, or similar marketing platforms and tools is a plus
  • Interest in SaaS, education technology, or B2B marketing environments preferred
  • Ability to travel 15-20% to attend department summits, company events, and regional/sales events

Bonus Skills

  • Experience supporting marketing campaigns, events, or social media initiatives
  • Familiarity with email marketing platforms or marketing automation tools
  • Basic graphic design experience using Canva or Adobe Express
  • Experience with project management platforms such as Asana, Monday.com, or Airtable
  • Experience writing or editing marketing content
  • Interest in AI tools that improve marketing productivity and execution
  • Exposure to CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce
  • Experience working with K-12 education or other mission-driven organizations

Hanes Brands Australasia is hiring a

Remote Store Manager BONDS Mt Gravatt

Be In Good Company

  • Good People – Join our team at Bonds, where we create a supportive and inclusive environment and help people feel comfortable and confident every day
  • Learn & Grow – Structured training and leadership development programs to support your growth as a leader
  • Good Careers – Expand your career by growing internally within or across our different brands in retail management and support centre
  • Good Impact – Our community partnership with Minus18 supports LGBTQIA+ youth through peer support, education, training and safe spaces

About The Role

We are looking for a driven and enthusiastic Store Manager to join the team at our Bonds Mt Gravatt store.

This is a full-time position at 38 hours per week.

  • Lead by example to build an inclusive, high-performing team, while driving budgets, KPIs and great customer experiences
  • Create a strong customer-first environment where every interaction reflects the brand and a consistently high level of service
  • Coach and develop your team through regular on-the-spot feedback, support and ongoing capability building
  • Execute visual merchandising in-store, balancing brand guidelines, customer needs and store presentation with commercial judgement
  • Take ownership of stock processes and daily operations, keeping priorities clear to support smooth day-to-day running

Good Benefits & Perks

  • Enjoy a 3-day weekend every month, plus your standard Sunday and Monday RDOs
  • Receive up to 50% discount off Hanes Brands, including Sheridan, Bonds and Bras N Things, plus 30% discounts for your family and friends
  • Receive up to $1,000 clothing allowance per year to spend on Bonds products ($250 each quarter)
  • Be eligible for monthly cash bonuses through our Retail Incentive Scheme
  • Take care of your physical and mental health with discounted health insurance and our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Enjoy wellness days, giving you time to focus on your wellbeing
  • Sales and Leadership + Retail Leadership Pathways Program to support your growth
  • Participate in incentive-based competitions during peak periods, with opportunities to earn bonuses and prizes
  • Receive a referral bonus of $1,000 when you recommend someone for retail management or support centre roles
  • Be recognised through service awards at 5, 10, 15 and 20+ years
  • Bonds baby bundles for expecting parents, plus up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave

Bonds x Hanes Brands

An iconic household name with a century of experience in making things comfortable – that’s us. We’re an open, collaborative and straight-talking workplace, always looking for better ways to support our people, our customers and our future. Most of all, we’re passionate about creating high-quality products that help make every day more comfortable for everyone.

Bonds is part of Hanes Brands Australasia, home to some of Australia’s most iconic apparel and lifestyle brands including Sheridan and Bras N Things. At Hanes, we pride ourselves on a supportive and inclusive culture, as well as our commitment to creating good impact on our community and planet. Our career pathways span across retail, management, and our two support centres located in Melbourne and Sydney—the possibilities for growth are endless!

Cultivating a Diverse and Inclusive Workplace

We are focused on cultivating a workplace that is diverse, inclusive and vibrant. In fact, we know both our workplace culture and business are only strengthened by our differences. We motivate our employees to bring their true selves to work and support them to reach their full potential both personally and professionally.

We warmly encourage people of all genders, races, ages, abilities, and any other backgrounds or differences to apply to work with us. We are especially committed to creating an accessible and supportive environment for people with a disability, and we encourage you to apply.

For more information, please email us at accessibility@hanes.com. For any non-accessibility-related enquiries, please contact careers@hanes.com.

Additional Information (Accessibility)

This role may involve extended time on your feet and supporting stock handling as part of daily store activities. If you require adjustments, we’re happy to discuss what works best for you.

If you need support or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know—we’re here to support you.

Nymbus is hiring a

Remote Enterprise IT Support Specialist

Nymbus (https://nymbus.com/) isn't just a leader in fintech; we're a community of innovators passionate about reimagining banking. Our award-winning modern core platform and cloud-based technology serve as the backbone for financial institutions eager to modernize and excel.

We operate with an AI-first mindset across our business, continuously improving how we work and the value we deliver to our clients. Our culture is grounded in collaboration, accountability, and a strong commitment to execution.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Nymbus is a remote-first company. Occasional travel may be required for client engagements, team planning sessions, or project activities. Working hours primarily align with the Eastern Time Zone; candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones are preferred. While standard business hours are expected, occasional after-hours support may be required for critical operational activities.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Enterprise IT Support Specialist provides day-to-day technical and operational support for Enterprise IT. This role is responsible for onboarding and offboarding employees, identity and access management, endpoint administration, and supporting the technologies employees rely on every day.

This is more than a traditional Help Desk role. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, improving processes, and leveraging AI and automation to make Enterprise IT more efficient.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support for employees across hardware, software, SaaS applications, and collaboration tools.
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve IT-related issues.
  • Manage onboarding, offboarding, account provisioning, and access changes.
  • Administer identity and access management, including SSO, MFA, user accounts, and permissions.
  • Configure, deploy, and support macOS and Windows devices using Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms.
  • Document, prioritize, and resolve support requests using the IT Service Management (ITSM) platform.
  • Maintain IT assets, software licensing, and operational documentation.
  • Collaborate with other IT teams to resolve technical issues and improve Enterprise IT operations.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 3+ years of experience in IT Support, Enterprise IT, or Systems Administration.
  • Experience supporting macOS and Windows environments.
  • Experience with identity and access management (IAM), Single Sign-On (SSO), and Mobile Device Management (MDM).
  • Experience with cloud-based SaaS applications and ITSM platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, organization, and customer service skills.
  • Self-starter with strong ownership, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with JumpCloud, Google Workspace, Jamf, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with Jira Service Management.
  • Familiarity with PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other automation tools.

AI-First Expectations

AI is transforming Enterprise IT, and we expect every member of our team to embrace it as part of how they work. Successful candidates will:

  • Think AI first before approaching repetitive or manual work.
  • Use AI to improve productivity, documentation, troubleshooting, and communication.
  • Identify opportunities to automate routine tasks and improve operational efficiency.
  • Continuously learn and apply new AI capabilities responsibly and securely.

SALARY & BENEFITS:

  • Hourly pay: $38.00
  • Annual Cash Bonus and Equity Options commensurate with the role level and experience
  • 100% Remote
  • 401(k) plan
  • Insurance - Health, Dental and Vision
  • Paid Time Off

Ready to join? We invite you to watch this video and learn who we are and how we build and innovates together!

Insight Global is hiring a

Remote Human Resources Generalist

Title: HR Generalist/Recruiter

Location: Remote (Washington State preferred)

6 month contract to hire

Pay: $30-32/hr


Required Skills & Experience


Qualifications:

- 3+ years of experience in Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, or a combined HR/Recruiting role.

- Experience managing payroll, benefits administration, and employee lifecycle processes.

- Proven full-cycle recruiting experience.

- Strong knowledge of employment laws and HR best practices.

- Experience with HRIS, payroll, and applicant tracking systems.

- Excellent communication, organizational, and relationship-building skills.

- Experience recruiting within legal, immigration, professional services, or consulting environments is preferred.


Job Description


Our client is seeking an HR Generalist & Recruiter to oversee all aspects of people operations and recruiting. This role is a 50/50 blend of Human Resources and Talent Acquisition, supporting a remote workforce while helping attract, hire, and retain top talent across legal, immigration, and business operations functions. The ideal candidate is a hands-on HR professional who is equally comfortable managing payroll and benefits as they are sourcing and recruiting candidates. This individual will serve as a trusted partner to leadership and help build scalable people processes to support continued growth.


Key Responsibilities:


Human Resources

- Administer employee benefits programs, enrollments, and employee support.

- Coordinate payroll processing and ensure accurate employee records.

- Manage workforce planning, employee onboarding, and offboarding activities.

- Maintain compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws.

- Support employee relations, performance management, and policy administration.

- Maintain HRIS and employee documentation.

- Partner with leadership on workforce management and organizational planning.


Talent Acquisition

- Lead full-cycle recruiting for legal, immigration, paralegal, attorney, case management, and corporate support positions.

- Partner with hiring managers to define hiring needs and recruitment strategies.

- Source, screen, interview, and coordinate candidates throughout the hiring process.

- Manage job postings, applicant tracking systems, and recruiting metrics. - Build talent pipelines for future hiring needs.

- Create a positive candidate experience and strengthen the employer brand.


Benefits packages for this role will start on the 1st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law

Call 4 Health is hiring a

Remote Nurse Manager

Job Details

Description

Job Summary

The Nurse Manager at Call 4 Health will oversee the daily operations of the Nurse Triage team, ensuring the highest quality of patient care, compliance with healthcare regulations, and optimal staff performance. This leadership role requires a licensed Registered Nurse (RN) with strong Operations and Triage expertise, managerial experience, and the ability to foster a supportive, high-performance work environment. This position will work closely with internal teams and directly with the customer to ensure seamless service delivery to patients.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Management:

  • Oversee the daily operations of the medical call center, ensuring efficient workflow and adherence to company policies.
  • Develop and implement operational strategies to improve service quality and patient and client satisfaction.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and ensure the team meets service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Collaborate with IT and technical teams to ensure seamless call center operations and troubleshoot issues.
  • Ensure appropriate call triage protocols are followed, directing patients to the proper level of care.

Staff Supervision & Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and supervise a team of nurses and support staff.
  • Conduct staff training and professional development programs to enhance clinical and communication skills.
  • Manage staffing schedules, ensuring adequate coverage to meet call center demands.
  • Conduct performance evaluations, provide constructive feedback, and implement corrective actions when needed.
  • Foster a positive work environment that promotes teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Patient Care & Quality Assurance

  • Ensure adherence to clinical guidelines and best practices for patient care.
  • Monitor calls and interactions to assess quality, compliance, and patient satisfaction.
  • Address patient complaints, concerns, and escalations in a timely and professional manner.
  • Maintain compliance with HIPAA, state, and federal healthcare regulations.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Act as a liaison between the call center, our clients, and external stakeholders.
  • Communicate effectively with executives, medical directors, and operational teams to align strategies and goals.
  • Report on KPIs, overall performance, patient feedback, and operational efficiencies.
  • Participate in company meetings, strategy sessions, and policy development initiatives.

Education And/or Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing (BSN) required; Master’s in Healthcare Administration (MHA) or Nursing (MSN) preferred.
  • Licensure: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license (CPT).
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of Triage experience with at least 2 years in a leadership/managerial role. Experience a telehealth setting is preferred.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Strong leadership and team management abilities.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Proficiency in call center technology, electronic medical records (EMRs), and telehealth platforms.
  • Ability to analyze data, monitor performance metrics, and implement improvement strategies.
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare regulations, HIPAA compliance, and best practices in patient care.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Ability to sit for extended periods and engage in active listening.
  • Occasional standing and use of hands for office equipment.
  • Ability to hear within normal range and use a headset.
  • Good visual acuity for reading screens and documents.
  • Ability to work remotely in a HIPAA-compliant workspace.
  • Ability to house company equipment and access broadband Internet.
  • Participation in meetings via telephone or video.

Work Environment

  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Maintain professional relationships with diverse personalities.
  • Adaptable to change and effective in managing stress.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Paid time off (PTO) and holidays.
  • Retirement plan options.
  • Fully Remote.

PatientIQ is hiring a

Remote Strategy and Operations Lead

About PatientIQ

PatientIQ is a fast-growing health tech company on a mission to improve patient outcomes. We partner with healthcare providers, medical device companies, and researchers to collect, analyze, and act on patient-reported outcomes data at scale — powering smarter clinical decisions and accelerating the future of value-based care.

Headquartered in Chicago and backed by top-tier venture capital and major health system investors, PatientIQ is building the largest platform for healthcare providers, industry partners, and researchers to collaborate on what matters most: helping patients get better.

The opportunity

PatientIQ is hiring a Strategy & Operations Lead to help drive the company's highest-priority strategic initiatives and strengthen the operating foundation required for our next phase of growth.

Working directly with the Chief of Staff and executive leadership team, you'll help build and scale our Strategic Program Office (SPO) - a new function responsible for governing the company's portfolio of strategic initiatives while improving how we plan, communicate, and execute across the business.

This role is ideal for a highly analytical operator who thrives in ambiguity, brings structure to complex problems, and enjoys turning strategy into execution.

What You'll Do

  • Own PatientIQ's portfolio of strategic initiatives—governing the company's highest-priority work from prioritization through execution, ensuring every initiative has clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and executive visibility
  • Lead complex cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution, partnering across Product, Commercial, Customer Success, Engineering, Finance, and Operations to deliver measurable business results
  • Help build and scale PatientIQ's Strategic Program Office (SPO) by establishing the governance, operating cadence, portfolio management, and accountability mechanisms that enable the company to execute at scale
  • Partner with the Chief of Staff and executive leadership team on strategic planning, executive operating rhythms, organizational priorities, board and leadership communications, and other high-impact initiatives critical to the business
  • Develop executive-ready analyses, recommendations, and communications that translate complex information into clear decisions, align stakeholders, and enable faster, higher-quality execution
  • Define and measure business impact by establishing KPI frameworks, tracking strategic initiatives, surfacing risks early, and ensuring investments deliver measurable operational and commercial outcomes
  • Champion AI-enabled ways of working by standardizing AI-powered workflows, automating manual processes, and embedding AI into how teams plan, communicate, analyze, and execute—creating meaningful leverage across the organization
  • Drive accountability across the organization by clarifying ownership, facilitating decision-making, removing execution roadblocks, and maintaining momentum on the company's most important priorities

What Success Looks Like

We believe clarity drives performance. Here's what the first 90 days look like in this role:

30 days - Build strong relationships with executive stakeholders and functional leaders. Develop a deep understanding of PatientIQ's business, product, customers, strategic priorities, and operating cadence. Begin identifying opportunities to improve execution, communication, and operational efficiency. Become proficient with the company's AI tools and workflows.

60 days - Independently own one or more executive operating cadences. Lead a cross-functional strategic initiative with minimal oversight. Deliver executive-ready analyses and communications that enable faster decision-making. Begin establishing the SPO framework

90 days - Be recognized as a trusted partner to the Chief of Staff and executive team. Fully support the company's strategic initiative portfolio and executive reporting cadence. Launch the foundational components of the Strategic Program Office. Deliver measurable improvements in execution through AI-enabled workflows and standardized operating processes.

Requirements

What you bring

Required

  • 2-4 years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, or business operations at a high-growth SaaS or technology company
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous questions, identify the most important issues, and develop clear, actionable recommendations
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience producing concise, executive-ready materials independently
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives and drive accountability across teams without formal authority
  • Strong business judgment—you understand when to analyze further, when to make a recommendation, and when to push an organization toward a decision
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives while maintaining a clear view of the broader business context
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve, information may be incomplete, and the path forward is not always defined
  • High ownership mindset—you do not wait for perfect direction and are comfortable building structure, defining the work, and driving it to completion
  • Strong aptitude for AI and modern productivity tools, with an interest in using technology to improve analysis, communication, and organizational efficiency
  • Exposure to go-to-market strategy, revenue operations, product strategy, healthcare technology, or B2B SaaS is a strong differentiator
  • Bachelor's degree required

Nice to have

  • Previous experience in a healthcare technology environment

Benefits

Why PatientIQ

  • Mission-driven work. We're solving a hard problem that matters — improving patient outcomes through better data. Every person here is working on something real
  • True idea meritocracy. Great ideas win, regardless of title. We encourage every team member to challenge the status quo
  • World-class team. You'll work alongside people who are at the top of their fields in health tech, enterprise software, and clinical science
  • Fast-growing. We're building the largest platform for healthcare providers and industry to collaborate — and we're just getting started
  • Great benefits. Top-notch health, dental, and vision. 401(k). Flexible PTO — we trust you to take the time you need. Professional development stipends
  • Real ownership. This is not a role where you maintain someone else's playbook. You'll build, shape strategy, and see your impact directly

Kickstart your design career as a Junior Designer.

At VIRTRIO, we are dedicated to creating innovative and impactful solutions. Our diverse and inclusive workforce is the backbone of our success, driving us to achieve our mission of empowering individuals and communities. We value creativity, collaboration, and continuous growth, and we are looking for a talented Junior Designer to join our dynamic team.

As a Junior Designer, you will be an integral part of our creative team, contributing to a variety of projects across digital and print media. You will work closely with senior designers, marketing professionals, and other team members to create visually compelling designs that align with our brand’s vision and goals. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or an early-career designer looking to grow and develop their skills in a supportive and innovative environment.



"In this role, you’ll collaborate with senior designers to develop engaging visuals for digital and print media, support branding projects, and contribute fresh concepts in a dynamic, inclusive environment. Perfect for early-career designers eager to grow and make an impact."

{ Responsibilities }

Unlock your creativity: Key responsibilities.



  • Collaborate with the design team to create and refine visual content for digital platforms, including websites, social media, email campaigns, and online ads.
  • Assist in the design and production of print materials such as brochures, flyers, posters, and other marketing collateral.
  • Support the development of branding and identity projects, ensuring consistency across all visual assets.
  • Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute creative ideas to enhance project outcomes.
  • Work on multiple projects simultaneously, managing time effectively to meet deadlines.
  • Stay updated on design trends, tools, and technologies to bring fresh ideas and techniques to the team.



"Junior Designers are the creative force behind captivating visuals, transforming ideas into compelling designs that elevate brand identity and engage audiences across diverse platforms."

{ Requirements }

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and other relevant design software.
  • A strong portfolio showcasing a range of design work across various media.
  • Basic understanding of HTML/CSS is a plus.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a keen eye for aesthetics.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to take constructive feedback.
  • Self-motivated and eager to develop, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

"A Junior Designer must possess a keen eye for detail, a flair for creativity, and proficiency in design tools, all while being adaptable and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment."

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity for professional growth and career development.
  • A supportive and inclusive work environment that values diversity and creativity.

Campari Group is hiring a

Remote Off Trade Channel Manager

Campari Group today is a major player in the global branded spirits industry, with a portfolio of over 50 premium and super premium brands, marketed and distributed in over 190 markets around the world, with leading positions in Europe and the Americas.

Headquartered in Milan, Italy, Campari Group owns 22 plants worldwide and has its own distribution network in 22 countries, and employs approximately 4,000 people.

Shares of the parent company Davide Campari - Milano N.V. are listed on the Italian Stock Exchange since 2001. Campari Group is today the sixth-largest player worldwide in the premium spirits industry.

Role Overview

The Off Trade Channel Manager will be responsible for managing all wholesalers (about 70% of total business), the entire retail channel, duty free, and hotel gift shops throughout Jamaica. The scope is island-wide and requires direct engagement with customers and accounts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the Off Trade Channel Plan for all brands in the portfolio (Campari, Magnum, White Room, Sky, etc.).
  • Manage BTL promotions and ensure the right POSM is in the right place.
  • Lead relationships with key accounts and monitor ROI, optimizing A&P investments.
  • Conduct trade visits and competitor analysis.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with brand and commercial teams.
  • Directly manage external agencies (e.g., TMS for merchandisers) and suppliers for displays, gondolas, and POP/POSM printing.
  • Accountable for managing the contract process and procure-to-pay procedures for all off trade activities.

What We Are Looking For

  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in trade marketing, sales, or marketing (off trade channel experience preferred).
  • Experience in the spirits or beverage industry is a strong plus.
  • Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field is preferred but not mandatory.
  • Strong project management, communication, and analytical skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel is essential); Power BI or other business tools are a plus.
  • Must own and operate a reliable motor vehicle.
  • Innovative, adaptable, and results-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders.

Location: Kingston, Jamaica (responsible for accounts island-wide).

Travel: Frequent, approximately 60% of the time, across Jamaica. Includes regular visits to supermarkets, wholesalers, duty free, and hotel gift shops.

At Campari Group we believe in building more value together, thus we see diversity in all forms as a source of enrichment. Our employment policies and practices ensure that we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment without regard to any individual’s race, religion, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or characteristics or expression, political affiliation or activity, age, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Note to applicants:

Your application will be assessed based on your abilities, expertise, general knowledge and experience, not because of any confidential, proprietary or trade secret information you may possess. You must not disclose to Campari Group any such information. In the event that you are asked a question that cannot be answered without disclosure of any confidential, proprietary or trade secret information (including from a current or prior employer or their vendors or customers), you must decline to answer the question.

Johnson & Johnson MedTech is hiring a

Remote Regional Sales Manager

Job Function

MedTech Sales

Job Sub Function

Clinical Sales – Surgeons (Commission)

Job Category

People Leader

All Job Posting Locations:

Kolkata, West Bengal, India

Job Description

In India, Johnson & Johnson operates as a single legal entity and consists of the strategic business units, Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices & Diagnostics, which are independently managed and report into their respective Global business segments.

J&J MedTech India (JJMT) is the market leader in the Medical Company Devices & Diagnostics Industry in India. It is in the business of caring and providing solutions to doctors, patients and nurses. It comprises of multiple Franchises (Strategic business units) providing healthcare solutions across Vision Care, Orthopaedics, Infection Prevention, Wound Management, Women’s health, minimally invasive surgery, Circulatory disease management, and Blood glucose monitoring and insulin delivery.

Position Title: Regional Sales Manager

Role Type: People Manager

Department Name / Franchise: AESS

Sector: Medical Devices

Position Location: Guwahati

Reports to (Title / Designation): General Sales Manager- East

Role Overview: Leads a group of Individual Contributors to achieve/exceed sales targets for the AESS Franchise within a designated territory- North East, and in a manner, consistent with the CREDO, company policy and goals. Has expert knowledge of the products responsible, and a good understanding of the other J&J products and service offerings. Has in-depth knowledge customer's needs and sharpened competitive knowledge and market trends. Works with all levels of customer management and develops long-term positive customer relationships, building loyalty and confidence in J&J Medical as a preferred supplier. can plan, assign work, motivate and coach the team while assuming responsibility for results of the team.

Illustrative Responsibilities

Sales Turnover

  • Sell franchise products within a territory in various market segments.
  • Make significant contribution to the development of the region's business plan by implementing the strategic imperatives of the franchise.
  • Provide weekly and monthly sales action plan to manager, reflecting the activities required in each account to achieve sales objectives.
  • Anticipate unfavorable variance in sales and provide inputs and follow-up actions to prevent/close the gap
  • Successfully negotiate and close complex deals in key accounts and with key customers.
  • Lead in organizing trade displays and Conferences when required.

Territory Management

  • Conduct SWOT analysis for the territory responsible
  • Develop/implement sales strategies and plans to achieve sales target
  • Set realistic, attainable sales objectives by account and product group, and by monthly, quarterly, and annual targets
  • In-depth understanding of customer needs to identify sales opportunities
  • Tender management to participate in tenders for State and central owned govt institutions
  • Actively pursue contract opportunities
  • Responsible for maintaining/gaining market share in the territories handled as per plans
  • Creatively plan for expansion of challenging territories and conversion of difficult accounts
  • Identify opportunities for tapping into new market segments
  • Participate in developing promotional support materials for use during sales calls
  • Has broad understanding of internal organization (J&J) resources, priorities, needs relating to the business operations and achievement of sales plan
  • Has detailed knowledge of sales processes and expert selling skills to make effective sales call, to teach others, and to improve on current process

Inspiration Commerce Group is hiring a

Remote Customer Support Agent · �

About Inspiration Commerce Group (ICG)

We’re a team of ~50 people who’ve done 6 acquisitions in 18 months and scaled from $0 to >$100M in revenue. We’re a global group with businesses across the US, UK, and EU. We buy and build companies that help people find and buy the products they love. Our portfolio includes leading fashion marketplaces like Italist, HEWI and Verishop, affiliate marketing platforms like Stylight and MyBestBrands, B2B technology solutions like Bonsai, and niche Marketplaces in the Creator and Construction spaces like Everpress and DOZR.

About This Role

Italist and HEWI are two luxury fashion marketplaces — one focused on new-season pieces sourced directly from Italian boutiques, the other on pre-loved luxury goods — and together they serve shoppers across the globe. As a Customer Support Agent, you'll be the first point of contact for our customers: answering questions, resolving issues, and making sure every interaction leaves them feeling heard and taken care of.

This is a fully remote role. You'll work closely with a small, tight-knit CS team and be expected to bring professionalism, empathy, and a real sense of ownership to every ticket you touch.

What You'll Do

  • Handle inbound customer inquiries across email and chat through Gorgias, our customer support platform — covering order status, returns, shipping, sizing, and everything in between — for either Italist or HEWI
  • Resolve issues efficiently and thoroughly, escalating to the team lead when a situation calls for it
  • Navigate Shopify and our customs admin to look up orders, track shipments, and assist with post-purchase queries across both stores
  • Maintain accurate records and follow established SOPs, while flagging anything that seems broken or improvable
  • Represent two luxury brands with warmth and professionalism in every customer interaction
  • Collaborate with teammates across time zones to ensure consistent coverage and quality

About You

  • You have hands-on experience in a customer-facing support role — e-commerce or fashion experience is a plus
  • You're calm under pressure, empathetic with frustrated customers, and quick to find solutions
  • Ownership Mentality: You don't wait to be told what to do. If a ticket needs solving, you solve it — and if something keeps going wrong, you flag it rather than work around it quietly
  • You're comfortable working independently in a remote environment with minimal hand-holding
  • Experience with Gorgias or similar helpdesk tools (Zendesk, Freshdesk) is a meaningful advantage; familiarity with Shopify is a plus
  • You're fluent in English; additional languages (Italian, French, German, Arabic, Japanise) are a genuine advantage given our customer base
  • You're okay with some structure and some ambiguity — startups are a mix of both

What We Can Offer You

  • A starting salary in the €1200–€1,600 range (gross) per month for 40h work week + 20 days of vacation per year (compensation range varies based on candidates experience and performance during interviews)
  • A fully remote, flexible work environment — we hire adults and treat them like adults
  • Real exposure to luxury e-commerce operations across two global brands
  • A small team where your work is visible, your feedback is heard, and there's room to grow

A Note on the Contract

This is a full-time B2B engagement — meaning we'll work with you as an independent contractor rather than a direct employee. We operate this way because ICG does not currently have a legal entity in Croatia. All compensation is quoted and paid gross; you'll be responsible for your own tax and social contributions on your end. If you're already set up as a sole proprietor (e.g. paušalni obrt or d.o.o.) or open to setting one up, this arrangement is straightforward. We're happy to walk you through how it works during the process.

What We Can't Offer You

  • A formal employment contract. This is a B2B engagement — see above.
  • Perfect work/life balance all the time. Startups move fast, and customer needs don't follow a 9-to-5 schedule. We'll work together to keep things reasonable, but flexibility goes both ways (we do not expect employees to work more then 8h a day)
  • A large support infrastructure to hide behind. You'll need to think on your feet and adapt quickly.

Our Process

  • Application — We'll review within 72 hours and follow up either way
  • Intro Call — A short conversation with Jurica or another team member to get to know each other (30 min, Google Meet).
  • Skills Assessment — A brief, practical exercise to see how you handle a realistic support scenario.
  • Final Interview — A deeper conversation with Karlo, including time for your questions.
  • Offer — The fun part.

If you have any questions at any point, feel free to reach out directly.

Blue Oak Consulting is hiring a

Remote Data Analyst Assistant

We are adding a Data Analyst Assistant to the team to support a large scale engagement with an established Italian infrastructure group. This position focuses on interrogating financial assumptions and identifying discrepancies in complex portfolios to ensure our partner makes decisions based on hard evidence rather than corporate narratives.

About Blue Oak Consulting
 Blue Oak Consulting provides independent advisory on pricing, portfolio economics, capital allocation, and acquisition assumptions. We are not a traditional consulting firm focused on broad transformation programs or high level strategy decks. Instead, we interrogate specific commercial decisions where the financial stakes are high and the existing narrative is not sufficient. Our team looks past corporate language and P&L complexity to identify where value is leaking or capital is trapped. We work across sectors like software, manufacturing, and healthcare to test whether the assumptions behind a growth plan or an acquisition actually hold under pressure. We are a small, principal led firm where the people who do the work are the ones accountable for the results. We do not take transaction contingent fees, which allows us to be completely honest about whether the economics of a decision make sense. Our goal is to provide clarity through financial discipline and a healthy amount of skepticism.

The Role
 This is a full time, permanent position that is conducted entirely in a remote environment. You will work closely with our principals to dig into the numbers provided by our partners, often starting with the Italian infrastructure project. The goal is to move past P&L complexity and find where value might be leaking. You will be expected to think critically and ask why certain numbers exist high up in a spreadsheet, rather than just accepting them as facts. This role offers an attractive and competitive compensation package for an entry level professional looking to gain deep experience in financial analysis.

What You Will Be Doing
  • Cleaning and organizing large datasets from various sources to build a clear financial picture.
  • Testing the logic behind pricing assumptions to see if they survive real world friction.
  • Helping build financial models that track capital allocation across different infrastructure assets.
  • Identifying outliers and anomalies in expenditure reports that do not align with the stated narrative.
  • Updating portfolio economics trackers to reflect new acquisition data.
  • Collaborating with the team through virtual channels to clarify findings and refine analysis.
  • Preparing clear summaries of data trends that highlight potential financial risks.
  • Verifying the accuracy of inputs used in growth forecasts for specific business units.
  • Assisting in the interrogation of acquisition assumptions for new investment opportunities.


What You Bring
  • A degree or background in finance, economics, mathematics, or a related field with a heavy emphasis on data.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to manage complex formulas and large tables.
  • A skeptical mindset that enjoys finding inconsistencies in spreadsheets and reports.
  • Comfort working in a fully remote setting where communication is largely written and specific.
  • Ability to organize messy data into structured formats without losing important context.
  • Interest in how large businesses actually spend money and allocate internal capital.
  • Reliability and a willingness to learn how to scrutinize financial statements at a deep level.
  • Strong attention to detail, especially when reviewing line items that seem out of place.


What We Offer
  • A fully remote work schedule that provides flexibility and removes the need for a daily commute.
  • Direct access to firm principals who provide mentorship and clear feedback on your work.
  • The opportunity to work on high stakes projects, such as our current work with the Italian infrastructure group.
  • A professional environment focused on logic and evidence rather than corporate politics.
  • Practical training in financial modeling and capital allocation analysis.
  • A permanent, stable role within a firm that values individual accountability and results.


At Blue Oak Consulting, we believe that clarity comes from discipline and a healthy amount of skepticism. We stay through the execution phase of our projects because we know that decisions looking sound in theory often face challenges once they meet reality. This role is a starting point for someone who wants to understand the mechanics of how value is created and protected in large organizations. We value the work over the performance, and we look for assistants who are eager to show how the numbers actually add up without relying on corporate jargon.

Descrição

Buscamos para um de nossos clientes internacionais, um(a) desenvolvedor(a) para atuar com automações, IA aplicada e manutenção do nosso banco de dados relacional, dando continuidade a projetos existentes e implementando novas soluções conforme a demanda. Além de executar, a pessoa deve buscar ativamente oportunidades de aplicar IA para melhorar processos da empresa.

Atribuições

  • Construir e manter automações de processos (N8N), integrando sistemas internos e externos.
  • Montar novos fluxos no N8N conforme a necessidade do time.
  • Buscar dados e construir APIs para integrar informações às automações e sistemas.
  • Dar continuidade a dashboards e projetos existentes (Looker Studio) e implementar novas soluções usando ferramentas de IA (Bubble, Replit).
  • Gerenciar a infraestrutura em nuvem (VPS/AWS) necessária para rodar automações e integrações.
  • Propor e testar novas abordagens de IA aplicadas ao nosso contexto.
  • Aplicar Machine Learning quando fizer sentido para o negócio.
  • Documentar as automações e integrações criadas.
  • Seguir boas práticas básicas de segurança (gestão de credenciais e variáveis de ambiente, controle de acesso) nos projetos que implementa.

  • Docker
  • Git
  • Inglês para leitura de documentação técnica

Diferenciais

  • NoSQL
  • TypeScript

Perfil esperado

  • Pleno / Sênior, com experiência comprovada desempenhando essas atividades.
  • Tomada de decisão: capacidade de decidir e resolver sem precisar de aprovação constante
  • Proatividade: buscar ativamente formas de aplicar IA e melhorar processos, não só executar o que é pedido.
  • Trabalho em equipe: boa comunicação com o time, mesmo trabalhando de forma independente.
  • Aprendizado contínuo: em constante atualização com as novas tecnologias do mercado de IA.
